facts.claim: The shop directs visitors to street parking in front and across the street, excluding the green-curb space. It also identifies a public lot across from the fire station, beyond Tuba Baking Co.; designated spaces and the complete route are unverified.
quote: street parking in front of the store + across the street (do not park in the space along the street with the green curb)
public lot parking down the road across from the fire station - on the other side of tuba baking co.

facts.claim: The 2026 Cincy Bookstore Crawl guide describes one step into the older building. It gives no alternative entrance or ramp arrangement; confirm current entry options before travel.
facts.quote: Public parking lots. Older building with one step up to get into the store.

facts.claim: Regular hours are Thursday–Friday 2–6 p.m. and Saturday 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; Sunday through Wednesday are listed as closed. In-store special events can have different hours.
quote: hours will differ for in-store special events

facts.claim: The creator space has drawing tables and art supplies, plus a stage, sound system and projector for events. The shop does not describe stage access, captioning or quieter sessions.
quote: the creator space is set up with drawing tables and stocked with art supplies
with a stage, sound system, and projector for visual elements

facts.claim: The Dayton shop lists 513-360-8519 for visit questions, including confirming entry arrangements.
